title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30223: add IsHandled events to Purchase Line (translation, price calc, WMS)
summary: Three new IsHandled integration events are added to the Purchase Line table, enabling extensions to intervene in item translation, location-based price calculation, and WMS location checks.
key_points: OnCopyFromItemOnBeforeGetItemTranslation event lets subscribers skip standard item translation
OnValidateLocationCodeOnBeforePlanPriceCalcByField event allows conditional price planning replacement
OnBeforeCheckWMS event enables bypassing standard WMS location validation
Events pass relevant record context (Rec, xRec, CurrFieldNo) for conditional logic
Changes applied consistently across all localization layers (W1, APAC, BE, CH, DACH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU, SE)
